svg.title: How many of 21 proteomic aging clocks moved on semaglutide vs placebo, by trial and week
svg.desc: Counts of the 21 clocks significantly younger or older on semaglutide than placebo after Holm-Bonferroni correction, from the Novo Nordisk preprint. SELECT week 20: 3 younger, 1 older; SELECT (survey-weighted to the full trial) week 20: 1 younger, 1 older; STEP-HFpEF week 20: 1 younger, 2 older; STEP-HFpEF week 52: 0 younger, 0 older; STEP-HFpEF DM week 20: 4 younger, 0 older; STEP-HFpEF DM week 52: 13 younger, 0 older; FLOW week 12: 4 younger, 1 older; FLOW week 52: 14 younger, 0 older; FLOW week 156: 17 younger, 0 older; SOUL week 13: 3 younger, 3 older; SOUL week 104: 9 younger, 0 older.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Most “younger” clocks came from diabetes trials after a year or more
